summary: The test suite is exceptional, comprehensively covering all functional requirements, static GitHub Actions workflow validation, and end-to-end pipeline execution via `act`. It rigorously tests complex edge cases, error scenarios, JSON type preservation, and matrix size limits. The design is highly modular and robust, cleanly separating standard unit tests (bats), workflow structural tests (bats + actionlint), and isolated CI integration tests (custom bash harness managing temp git repos).
